name: HouseLayout3D-inspired geometry ablation v1
implemented: Source HM3D semantic triangle normals + area-weighted vertical wall-plane RANSAC per instance
Projected wall intervals retaining gaps >4cm; minimum segment length 25cm; local displacement limited to 6cm
RDP polygon boundary simplification at 3cm tolerance; non-Manhattan directions allowed
Matched bounds, 1cm resolution, fixed floor/ceiling/object-support masks, frozen old inferred walls
Unfitted walls retained; explicit A/B/C ablation and changed-connectivity diagnostics
not_implemented: Full jointly optimized 3D polygons and Lprox/Lempty/Lconnect/Lsimple losses
Real camera/depth-ray empty-space constraints and evidence-guided wall extension
Hov-SG room graph, door/stair extraction, ceiling extrusion
fairness: This isolates geometric regularization with existing input/support masks. It is not an independent end-to-end HouseLayout3D or MultiFloor3D benchmark. Metrics compare to baseline A, not ground truth.
